mechanism: congestion-aware out-of-order dual-NoC drain: per tile, NoC0-eligible (short-eastward bank) tiles go on whichever NoC has the smaller posted-write backlog (NIU unsent + busy cmd buf), NoC1-only tiles go when NoC1 is no more backed up, tiles issue out of order across the ready part of the row, one flush+pop per row instead of per block
